ex.en: Sue has the [ability] to succeed in business.
ex.zh: 苏有能力在商业上取得成功。

der.zh: 丧失能力的；有残疾的；无能力的

nph.zh: n. 商业（busy 变 y 为 i，加 -ness）

ntip: dis- 表示否定，构成反义动词：able → disable

ex.en: Leave the reference books behind, or you won't be [able] to think by yourself.
ex.zh: 把参考书放一边，否则你将无法独立思考。

ex.en: It takes [about] half an hour to ride from this park to Shanghai Museum.
ex.zh: 从这个公园骑车到上海博物馆大约需要半个小时。

ex.en: Mr. Johnson is always kind to his students and he really cares [about] them.
ex.zh: 约翰逊先生对他的学生总是很好，他真的很关心他们。

ex.en: You'd better not ask too many personal questions [about] someone's age and salary.
ex.zh: 你最好不要问太多关于某人年龄和薪水的私人问题。

ph.en: how [about] doing sth. = what about doing sth.

ex.en: Keep your head [above] the water.
ex.zh: 保持头部在水面以上。

ex.en: This job requires a bachelor's degree or [above].
ex.zh: 这份工作需要本科及以上学历。

ph.zh: 首先，尤其是；最重要的是

tips.title: 名师点拨
lines: above 是常考单词，所以学生一定要知道 above、over 和 on 在表示位置时的用法区别：
above 指笼统的上方，表示位置之高；反义词为 below。例如：The water came above our knees. 水没过了我们的膝盖。
over 指垂直的上方，比较精确，反义词为 under。例如：The light is over my head. 灯在我头顶上方。
on 指“在……上面”，两者有表面接触，表示一件东西在另一件之上。例如：There is a book on the desk. 桌子上有一本书。

ex.en: He had to make a choice between staying with his parents and going [abroad].
ex.zh: 与父母住在一起还是出国，他不得不作出选择。

ex.en: My brother is living [abroad].
ex.zh: 我哥哥在国外生活。

tips.title: 名师点拨
lines: abroad 是常考单词，所以学生一定要掌握其固定搭配：abroad 前面不能加 to 或 in，因为 abroad 是副词。

ex.en: They [accepted] responsibility for the accident.
ex.zh: 他们承担了这次事故的责任。

ex.en: He was injured in a traffic [accident].
ex.zh: 他在一次交通事故中受伤。

ntip: by accident 在句中作状语，相当于副词 accidentally

ex.en: The manager impressed on his office staff the importance of keeping [accurate] records.
ex.zh: 经理让办公室职员认识到做精确记录的重要性。

nph.zh: 让某人认识到某事（sth. 是名词）

ex.en: She could feel an [ache] in her back.
ex.zh: 她能感觉到背部的疼痛。

ex.en: My head [aches] after studying for a long time.
ex.zh: 长时间学习后，我的头很疼。

ex.en: As an English learner, the larger vocabulary you have, the more success you may [achieve].
ex.zh: 作为一名英语学习者，你的词汇量越大，你最终获得的成功也就越大。

ex.en: She ran [across] the field to catch up with her friends.
ex.zh: 她跑过田野赶上朋友们。

ex.en: The river measures about 30 metres [across].
ex.zh: 这条河宽约 30 米。

der.zh: n. 十字形的东西；v. 越过，穿过

ex.en: The actor who [acted] in the TV series last night became famous in his thirties.
ex.zh: 昨晚电视剧中的这位演员，在他 30 多岁时就成名了。

ex.en: His selfless [act] of kindness touched everyone's heart.
ex.zh: 他无私的善举触动了每个人的心。

der.zh: 积极的；活跃的；充满活力的

nph.zh: 在某人三十多岁时（同理 teens / twenties …）

ntip: 例句里 who acted in the TV series last night 修饰前面的 the actor（定语从句）

senses.zh: 积极的；活跃的；充满活力的

ex.en: They took an [active] part in the singing competition yesterday.
ex.zh: 他们昨天积极参加了唱歌比赛。

ex.en: Our school club offers various [activities], such as singing, gardening, and robotics.
ex.zh: 我们的学校社团提供各种各样的活动，如唱歌、园艺和机器人制作。

nph.zh: 例如 A、B 和 C（≈ for example）

ex.en: Nowadays too many boys want to become [actors].
ex.zh: 现在太多男孩都想成为演员。

ex.en: Emma, an [actress], has become a superstar because of her hard work and talent.
ex.zh: 艾玛是一位女演员，因为她的努力和才华成为了超级明星。

ntip: an actress 补充说明 Emma 是谁，相当于 (who is) an actress
